items.title: BURPEE-SWITCH
items.summary: A container-style extension for Chrome, Brave, Edge and other Chromium browsers that keeps multiple accounts — work, personal, client — open in the same window, with a container, its own cookies, colour and label per tab. Adds optional login-storage isolation, per-site container rules, session restore, and an optional Burp Suite highlighter JAR that colours proxy history rows by container. Stays local: no accounts, cloud, analytics or telemetry. Open source under the MIT licence.
